## Module Overview

### Module summary

Predicts a surface (raster) of fire spread probabilities using a model previously fit with `fireSense_SpreadFit`.
fireSense [@Marchal:2017a; @Marchal:2017b; @Marchal:2019] <!-- TODO -->
